groups.title: Scope decision
groups.description: The recommendation is proposed; Antony has not accepted an amendment.

discussion.title: Can repair evaluation proceed while native cause remains unresolved?
discussion.summary: Recommend design of a justified correction using one activation request, with explicit repetition, deferral and speculative-yield exclusions. No candidate is established. The causal alternative needs an outcome-excluding prediction or an explicitly agreed statistical standard. Antony has accepted neither amendment; all runtime holds remain.

updatedDiagrams.summary: Accounts for the expanded native rows and separates marker sufficiency from necessity; one start reaches every branch.
Names candidate exclusions and the structural limit on finite causal testing; all six slots remain held.

diagrams.title: Why the current probe does not discriminate cause
diagrams.caption: Appearance, main-resignation and front/resume observations do not identify a matched intervention. Qualified failures can refute row-click or marker necessity only when absence is independently established; the broad rivals have no finite falsifier.

diagrams.title: Choose the proof required before repair evaluation
diagrams.caption: The proposed amendment permits design of a justified single-request correction, with repetition, deferral and speculative-yield exclusions. No candidate is established. The causal alternative lacks an outcome-excluding prediction; a rate model would require an agreed statistical standard. No guest is authorized.
